title: Navy suit, white shirt, black dress shoes
summary: The most useful business outfit: a navy suit, a crisp white shirt and black oxfords. Add a navy or burgundy tie, a black belt and navy socks.

title: Charcoal suit, light blue shirt, black dress shoes
summary: Charcoal is the most formal everyday suit colour; a light blue shirt softens it and a burgundy tie is the single accent. Black shoes and belt.

title: Suit without a tie, brown shoes
summary: A suit worn with an open collar reads modern rather than stiff. Brown derbies or loafers warm it up; keep the belt brown to match.

title: Navy blazer, grey trousers, shirt
summary: Odd jacket and trousers should contrast on purpose: navy over mid-grey is the classic pairing. Add a tie for meetings, drop it for dinner.

title: Tweed jacket, flannel trousers, oxford shirt
summary: Textured tweed needs equally wintry partners: flannel trousers and an oxford shirt. Brown brogues or derbies and a knitted tie finish it.

title: Dark suit for the evening
summary: For evening events go dark and simple: a navy or charcoal suit, a white shirt and polished black shoes. Lose the tie at a relaxed party.

title: Light summer jacket, open collar
summary: In warm weather a stone or light grey suit in linen or cotton looks fresh. A light blue shirt and brown suede loafers; ties optional.

title: Blazer with a fine turtleneck
summary: A fine merino turtleneck under a blazer is the polished alternative to shirt and tie. Keep the trousers dark and the shoes sleek.

title: Navy blazer, white oxford, beige chinos
summary: The everyday smart-casual uniform: navy jacket, white oxford, beige chinos. Brown suede loafers keep it relaxed; a brown belt ties it together.

title: Blazer with dark jeans
summary: Dark, clean jeans dress up easily: add an oxford shirt and a soft-shouldered blazer. Loafers or Chelsea boots finish it better than trainers.

title: Crewneck over a shirt, dark jeans, brown boots
summary: A crewneck over a button-down is warm and neat; let the collar sit outside the knit. Dark jeans and brown Chelsea boots keep it grown-up.

title: Navy knit, grey trousers, brown shoes
summary: Navy and grey is the safest smart combination there is. A fine crewneck over wool trousers works in most offices; add a collar for meetings.

title: Camel coat, dark turtleneck, grey trousers
summary: A camel coat lifts dark winter outfits instantly. Keep everything underneath dark and smooth so the coat stays the focus.

title: Trench coat, navy knit, grey trousers
summary: A trench is the transitional-season essential. A navy knit and grey trousers underneath still work once the coat comes off.

title: Knit polo, chinos, suede shoes
summary: A knitted polo sits between a T-shirt and a shirt: smart enough for the office, relaxed enough for dinner. Tuck it in and show a slim belt.

title: White linen shirt, light trousers, loafers
summary: Linen is meant to look a little relaxed; keep the colours light and the fit easy. Suede loafers without socks suit a summer evening.

title: Soft blazer over a white T-shirt
summary: A soft blazer over a plain white T-shirt is the modern smart-casual shortcut. Clean white leather sneakers or loafers both work.

title: Chambray shirt, chinos, suede chukkas
summary: A chambray shirt has denim's texture with a shirt's polish. Earthy chinos and suede chukkas keep the palette warm.

title: Corduroys, oxford shirt, navy crewneck
summary: Corduroy brings texture, so keep the rest plain: a navy crewneck over a light blue oxford and brown suede shoes.

title: Burgundy knit with grey and navy
summary: Burgundy is the easiest accent colour: it sits naturally with grey, navy and brown. Let it be the only colour in the outfit.

title: Cream cable knit, dark jeans, peacoat
summary: A chunky cream knit with dark denim is winter weekend comfort that still looks put together. Wear the knit untucked, a navy peacoat over the top.

title: Quarter-zip, chinos, clean sneakers
summary: A quarter-zip with a white T-shirt just visible at the neck is comfortable and tidy: great for travel days and relaxed offices.

title: Suede jacket, fine turtleneck, dark jeans
summary: Suede and soft knitwear make a warm, tactile pairing. Keep the jeans dark and the boots brown for a relaxed date-night look.

title: Black leather jacket, grey knit, black jeans
summary: A dark base with one matte grey layer keeps a leather jacket sharp rather than rock'n'roll. Black boots, no other shine.

title: Tonal dark evening layers
summary: Tonal charcoal and black look effortlessly elegant at night. Vary the textures (fine knit, flannel, wool coat) so it does not fall flat.

title: Grey knit, olive chinos, brown shoes
summary: Olive and grey are a quiet, grown-up pairing; brown shoes bridge the two.

title: Pink oxford, navy chinos, brown shoes
summary: A pale pink oxford is a confident spring alternative to blue; navy chinos and brown loafers keep it grounded.

title: White polo, navy trousers, brown shoes
summary: A white knitted polo with navy trousers is crisp summer evening wear. Tuck it in and add suede loafers.

title: Navy cardigan, white T-shirt, grey trousers
summary: A cardigan is a softer blazer. Over a white T-shirt with grey trousers it works for a creative office or a weekend lunch.

title: Field jacket, white T-shirt, dark jeans
summary: Military olive, white and indigo is a casual classic. Keep the jeans unripped and the sneakers clean.

title: Breton stripes, navy bottoms, white sneakers
summary: Navy-and-white stripes need nothing else patterned. Pair with navy or denim and white sneakers for an easy seaside feel.

title: White T-shirt, chino shorts, sneakers
summary: Summer basics done right: a good white T-shirt, chino shorts ending above the knee and clean white sneakers.

title: Flannel shirt over a T-shirt, jeans, boots
summary: Wear a flannel shirt open over a T-shirt as a light layer. Dark jeans and brown boots keep it rugged but neat.

title: Denim jacket, grey sweatshirt, black jeans
summary: Avoid double denim in the same wash: a denim jacket over grey with black jeans keeps the blues separate.

title: Down jacket, chunky knit, jeans, boots
summary: On the coldest days a down jacket over a chunky knit keeps you warm; brown boots and dark jeans stop it looking like ski gear.

title: Workwear jacket, grey T-shirt, dark jeans
summary: Workwear jackets look best with simple basics: a grey T-shirt, dark jeans and sturdy brown shoes.

title: Olive chinos, white T-shirt, navy cardigan
summary: Olive, navy and white is relaxed and easy to wear. Leave the cardigan open over the T-shirt.

title: Light jeans, knit polo, suede shoes
summary: Lighter denim is perfect for warm days; a navy knitted polo and suede loafers make it smart enough for dinner.

title: Sweatshirt, joggers, sneakers, bomber
summary: Elevated athleisure: a plain grey sweatshirt, tapered joggers without logos and clean sneakers. A bomber makes it city-ready.

title: Hoodie, joggers, down jacket
summary: Comfort for cold days: hoodie and joggers in one or two quiet colours, a down jacket on top.

title: Tech T-shirt, shorts, running shoes
summary: For an active weekend: a technical T-shirt, shorts and proper running shoes. Keep it to two colours.

title: Quarter-zip and joggers for travel
summary: Travel comfort that still looks tidy: a quarter-zip, soft trousers and white sneakers.

title: Windbreaker, T-shirt, cargo trousers, trail shoes
summary: For city walks or light hikes: a packable windbreaker, cargo trousers and trail shoes in earthy tones.

title: Piqué polo, chino shorts, white sneakers
summary: Sporty summer smart: a piqué polo, tailored chino shorts and white sneakers.
